purpose: Screen a recent MIMAROPA lake diet study for Bangwit's natural-diet evidence pipeline while withholding any app projection until its conflicting reuse notices are clarified.

study.title: Diet Composition and Feeding Habits of Naujan White Goby (Glossogobius aureus) in Naujan Lake, Philippines
study.samplingPeriodAsReported: Monthly sampling from February 2020 through January 2021.
study.waterbodyScope: Naujan Lake and six named fishing grounds around the lake, including river-mouth and outlet settings; this is not a basin-wide river survey.
study.samplingMethodAsReported: A 1,000 m gill net with approximately 1.5 cm mesh was set for eight hours; the paper describes a target of at least 50 adult fish per site and monthly sampling 2-3 days before the full moon. Do not convert this protocol or sample totals into catch rates or abundance.
siteContextAsReported: Butas (Site 1), Barangay Bayani, at the lake outlet toward Tablas Strait
study.habitatContext: The article reports salinity of 3-5 ppt at Site 1 only; do not generalize that measurement to the whole lake or all six sites.
study.identityMethod: Authors report morphological identification using pit-organ arrangement and sensory papillae. The reviewed article does not give a specimen-voucher crosswalk or molecular confirmation for the diet samples.
study.highLevelDietFinding: The publisher abstract and article describe shrimp as the main food group, followed by fish and other items, with diet varying by site and season. This concise source-level note is not a public diet row; no table, percentage, figure, or prey sequence was copied.

journalPageFooterNotices: The footer describes the article as CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
The footer also links a CC BY 4.0 license.
licenseReview.decision: Do not treat the page footer as overriding the article-specific license section. No percentage table, figure, transformed diet dataset, or public-app diet claim is cleared until the publisher or authors resolve which terms govern this item and authorize the intended use.

dietEvidenceLimits: The reported findings apply to sampled adult G. aureus in Naujan Lake over the stated period; juvenile diet was not assessed.
The article reports significant seasonal and site variation, so one fixed lake-wide prey list would hide observed context.
The study includes one outlet site with reported 3-5 ppt salinity and several river-mouth-associated sites; no salinity class should be assigned to all records.

Fish is a broad reported prey category; the reviewed article does not establish conspecific predation or name the fish prey species. Do not convert this into a cannibalism claim or bait recommendation.
The article's diet sample is not a current regional checklist, population estimate, water-quality assessment, fishing-permission source, or safety advisory.
The per-article and page-footer license statements conflict. The research summary is not a substitute for rights clearance.
nextAction: Seek written clarification of the article's governing license and whether a small attributed factual diet summary may be shown in Bangwit, including future commercial use. If permission is unavailable, keep this source as a citation-only research lead and prioritize sources with clear reusable terms.

sources.supports: Article metadata, sampling scope, named site context, abstract-level diet summary, methods, and the item-level license notice; the page footer separately presents conflicting license terms.
